d:
Anirudh Ravichander has given an international flavor to this beautiful romantic track Oh Oh, written and rendered by Dhanush along with Nikhita Gandhi for the film Thangamagan.
Song Name - Oh Oh
Movie - Thangamagan
Singer - Dhanush & Nikhita Gandhi
Music - Anirudh Ravichander
Lyrics - Dhanush
Director - Velraj
Starring - Dhanush, Amy Jackson, Samantha
